title: Hellenic
html_source:
Here Mulligan tries to atone for making fun of Stephen’s name by saying that, like Stephen’s last name, Mulligan’s first name has a somewhat Greek sound to it as well, due to its meter.

This will be repeated in the final episode when Molly Bloom has a go at their landlady and Leopold, then makes it up for it.
